data.one_liner: OpenTelemetry SDK for Dart and Flutter for distributed tracing, metrics, and context propagation.
data.what_it_does: Provides an OpenTelemetry SDK for Dart and Flutter applications. It enables distributed tracing, metrics collection, OTLP exporters (gRPC/HTTP), and context propagation for observability backends.
use_when: You need standard OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and metrics in Dart or Flutter.
You want to send telemetry data to an OTLP-compatible backend.
avoid_when: You do not need observability or distributed tracing in your application.
strengths: Supports all Dart and Flutter targets including mobile, desktop, web, and wasm.
Provides context propagation across async gaps and Isolates.
weaknesses: Requires manual code instrumentation or additional integration packages for automatic monitoring.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing the OTel class via code or environment variables.
